headline: Chief AI Officer | Professional Services AI Transformation | Strategic Alliances
executive_summary: Senior AI and professional services executive leading end-to-end AI/ML transformation and SaaS delivery across regulated financial services industries. Unified senior commercial and technical teams to accelerate onboarding by forty percent, strengthen delivery rigor, and improve client outcomes across twenty-plus enterprise engagements. Established audit-ready governance frameworks, regulatory modernization programs, and standardized delivery playbooks that enabled faster time-to-value and sustained compliance. Generated more than fifty million dollars in client impact by aligning strategic partnerships with Databricks and AWS, embedding AI governance into workflows, and delivering measurable outcomes that raised client renewals by twenty-five percent. Advanced professional services state-of-the-art by automating compliance workflows with LLM-powered discovery and transformer-based analytics, cutting remediation cycles by thirty-five percent and reducing delivery costs by twenty percent.
